tests.exercises: Official ITensor sample/tutorial driver mixedspin.cc.
tests.why: Official mixed spin-1/spin-1/2 DMRG driver and the module's most expensive deterministic workload (98 s under one CPU). The sweeps use noise and Global::random() is seeded from time+pid, so the run is not bit-reproducible by construction; six independent unmodified runs nevertheless reproduced the same converged ground-state energy to all ten printed decimals, so it is packaged as the acceleration-labelled check.
